summary: French native speaker, lives in London, web developer, strong technical background in JavaScript and web technologies, recurring interest in Docker and containerization, strong opinions on web standards and browser compatibility, critical of corporate practices in tech, engaged in discussions about privacy and surveillance, involved in projects related to offline web applications, experience with developing applications for unreliable networks in Africa, advocates for balanced diets and critiques meat consumption, expresses concerns about the state of democracy in France, active in discussions about the impact of technology on society, interested in open-source software and community-driven projects.
